qsm-docs doctor.description: Report whether git, the one program qsm-docs needs on PATH, is there

qsm-docs get.description: Print a snapshot exactly as it was created; fail when its file no longer matches the sha256 recorded at create

qsm-docs create.description: Convert a file with its kind's converter, store a copy that never changes and print its id <project>-<branch>-<timestamp>

args.name: kind
args.description: the kind of the document: json, or one a plugin installed with kind add

args.name: parent
args.description: the id of the snapshot this one was made from

args.name: project
args.description: the project (default: the directory name of the checkout's main worktree)

qsm-docs list.description: List the snapshots of a project newest first: id, kind, branch, time, parent, and whether a page made it

args.name: open
args.description: only proposals a page saved that no later snapshot names as its parent

qsm-docs diff.description: Name what changed between a snapshot and its parent, or two snapshots of one kind, through the kind's diff command

args.name: other
args.description: a second snapshot of the same kind, compared instead of the parent

qsm-docs delete.description: Remove a snapshot and record the delete in the ledger; the owner's verb, denied to the agent

qsm-docs kind add.description: Install a kind from its JSON manifest and keep a copy of its page directory

qsm-docs kind list.description: List the installed kinds with their media types, the built-in json first

qsm-docs kind remove.description: Remove a kind and its page files; every snapshot of it stays

qsm-docs serve.description: Serve every kind's page on 127.0.0.1: the page shell, the kind's page in a frame, and edit mode, where a save becomes a proposal

args.name: port
args.description: the port to listen on (default: 4748; 0 picks a free one)

args.name: project
args.description: the project a page opened without an id reads (default: the checkout's)

args.name: branch
args.description: the branch a page opened without an id reads (default: the checked-out branch)
